theorem.statement: A platform Evidence bundle is admissible only when all security-relevant artifacts are cross-bound to one capture session, one boot identity, one TPM identity, one PCR selection, one challenge, one toolchain snapshot, one reference-value version, one trusted-time object, and one event-log reconstruction result.

manifest_bindings.session_binding: The session_binding_sha256 covers the session/boot/TPM/event-log/PCR/challenge/AK/toolchain/reference/trusted-time/reconstruction identifiers in canonical form.
manifest_bindings.canonical_json: Manifest semantic hashing uses UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and no insignificant whitespace.

coherence_rules.rule: The selected TPM device path and observed TPM fixed-properties digest remain constant throughout the capture.
The boot_id must be stable before and after all TPM capture operations.
The event-log digest must match the event log named by the independent reconstruction result.
Quote PCR selection, reconstruction PCR selection, and live-observation selection must be byte-for-byte identical.

Quote qualifying data must equal the verifier challenge file byte-for-byte; challenge.sha256 and quote.nonce_sha256 must match that file, and the challenge must not be represented as the local wall clock.
The live post-quote PCR observation is supplied to tpm2_checkquote, so the quote's PCR values are compared with the live observation.
Quote cryptographic verification, event-log parsing, event-log reconstruction, reference appraisal, trusted time, and authorization remain distinct observations.

A parser-success result is insufficient: event-log reconstruction must explicitly report PASS, bind the exact event-log digest and PCR selection, and bind the reconstructed PCR result to the live observation.
Any unavailable or ambiguous trusted-time or reconstruction dependency is INDETERMINATE, never PASS.
Reference-value rollback, profile substitution, artifact substitution, or session-binding mismatch is DENY.
Any DENY anywhere outranks INDETERMINATE; any INDETERMINATE outranks PASS.

decision_algebra: ANY DENY > ANY INDETERMINATE > ALL PASS

execution_modes.self_test: Deterministic semantic coherence vectors; no hardware claim.
execution_modes.verify: Verify an existing bundle, check artifact hashes, validate reconstruction bindings, and cryptographically check the TPM Quote when tpm2_checkquote is available.
execution_modes.capture: Capture raw physical TPM/PC-client artifacts when compatible hardware and tools exist. The result remains unqualified until independent reconstruction and trusted-time evidence are valid.

capture_requirements.workload_pcr_note: PCR16 remains a separate workload-specific measurement surface and is not silently treated as a PC-client firmware event-log PCR.

reference_boundary.event_log_semantics: The PC-client event log is an input to reconstruction; parsing alone is not a trust decision.
reference_boundary.reference_values: Reference values are identified by version and digest and remain an independent appraisal input.
reference_boundary.trusted_time: Trusted time is an externally qualified evidence object; local wall-clock time is not authoritative.
reference_boundary.authorization: Coherent platform Evidence remains evidence only and is consumed by the downstream RATS/Relying-Party/PEP chain.
